name: Furwood University
source:
Furwood University is a light romance visual novel that takes place in a university located in the West United States! Talk about burning love!

You're 2nd out of 4 years of university has arrived! Maybe you should of dropped out... but wait! You're best friend is still here, Lavender! He always makes things better, right? or does he make you feel... things. Dwell deeper into gay panic and thoughts as you manage to keep the façade of a best friend to Lavender instead of a secret admirer. Maybe throw in a nice chat or a nice romantic date to keep things running! Will you be the bestest friend to Lav or will you be the love of his life?

[From [url=https://bunnyblue511.itch.io/furwood-university]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Furwood University》是一部轻松的恋爱视觉小说，故事发生在美国西部的一所大学。来谈一场炽热的恋爱吧！

四年大学生活，你已迎来第二年！也许当初就该退学…不过，等等！你最好的朋友Lavender还在这里！有他在，事情总会好起来，对吧？又或者，他会让你产生…某种心动。你一边因喜欢上同性而心慌意乱、思绪纷飞，一边努力维持Lavender好友的身份，掩藏自己暗恋他的事实。不妨来一场愉快的交谈，或一次浪漫的约会，让这段关系继续发展！你会成为Lav最好的朋友，还是他一生的挚爱？

[摘自[url=https://bunnyblue511.itch.io/furwood-university]itch.io[/url]]
